description: HAPTIC controller health, reconciliation, admission webhooks, configuration validation, deployment, and runtime observability.

panels.description: HAProxy pods the last deployment targeted (fleet size) vs. how many are now at the desired config (converged). A sustained gap means the fleet is diverged - the config a change applied has not reached every pod. Leader-only metrics (followers report 0), so this maxes across pods to show the leader's view.
